rungs.title: Delivery Coordinator
rungs.summary: Learning how teams plan, ship and improve.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the team's process, boards and release steps.
rungs.delivery: Keeps boards, releases and reports accurate for a delivery manager.
rungs.leadership: Facilitates simple ceremonies and writes clear updates.

rungs.title: Delivery Manager
rungs.summary: Gets a team to ship reliably and keeps improving how.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in agile practice, estimation, release management and the SDLC.
rungs.delivery: Owns a team's flow of work: plans, removes blockers and shows the evidence.
rungs.leadership: Facilitates the team, manages up and across, and resolves conflict early.

rungs.title: Senior Delivery Manager
rungs.knowledge: Deep in metrics, risk and dependency management; understands the technical constraints.
rungs.delivery: Owns delivery across several teams and the health of how they work.
rungs.leadership: Coaches other delivery managers and negotiates scope with leadership.

rungs.title: Head of Delivery
rungs.summary: Owns the delivery system for the company.
rungs.knowledge: Connects delivery capacity to strategy, budget and customers.
rungs.delivery: Owns delivery performance, capacity planning and the delivery budget.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and reports delivery risk to executives.
